nodes.name: Get Payment SLA Rows

nodes.name: Get Active Payment SLA
nodes.notes: Selects the SLA row to work on: newest ACTIVE, else newest PENDING, else (PAID event only) newest PAID_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS so a replay resumes at the email, else (CANCELLED event only) newest CANCEL_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS so a replay resumes at the Form.io patch, else newest EXPIRED (late PAID / CANCELLED). Emits slaLookup CLOSED when only PAID / CANCELLED / PAID_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS / CANCEL_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS rows exist.

parameters.content:
## Developer Overview – FOI Fee Payment Outcome

**Purpose:**
Handles the outcome of an online payment: PAID, CANCELLED or EXPIRED (feeAction = paid / cancel / expire). Each outcome is its own execution (no long-running Wait).

**Trigger/Entry:**
Sub-workflow called by **FOI Fee Processing** (router). Start node has fixed fields, so it can also be run on its own with a foi-manage-payment / foi-payment-expired item (see the Start node note). `Set Event Variables` normalises the fields.

**Processing:**
Find the SLA row (the newest ACTIVE row, else the newest PENDING row, else the newest EXPIRED row so a late PAID or CANCELLED after expiry is still handled; a PAID or CANCELLED outcome whose request only has closed rows is skipped as a duplicate), then:
- PAID → update the Form.io submission, mark the SLA row PAID_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS (so the expiry job can no longer pick it up), then send the confirmation email and close the row as PAID. A replayed PAID event that finds a PAID_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS row skips the Form.io patch and resumes at the email.
- CANCELLED → call the cancel-payment API, mark the SLA row CANCEL_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS (so the expiry job can no longer pick it up and a replay does not cancel twice), then set paymentstatus CANCELLED on the Form.io submission (skipped when there is no submission to patch) and close the row as CANCELLED. A replayed CANCELLED event that finds a CANCEL_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS row skips the cancel call and resumes at the Form.io patch.
- EXPIRED → if the row is still ACTIVE, first read the latest payment version (GET /api/foipayment/{requestid}/ministryrequest/{id}). Unpaid and not System_Cancel → send the expiry notification. Already paid or cancelled → close the row as PAID or CANCELLED with a comments note and send nothing. Lookup failed or empty → skip; the row stays ACTIVE and the next daily run retries.
Then close the SLA row (an EXPIRED row becomes PAID or CANCELLED).

**Integration/Outcome:**
Calls FOI Backend API Manager (foipayment-formsubmission-update, foipayment-cancel, foipayment-get, foinotifications-expiry) and FOI Email Processing. The API updates the Form.io submission (n8n does not log in to Form.io). Before each update, a Guard Form Ids node fails the run with a clear message if the SLA row has no form_id or submission_id. An expiry never updates the submission. Uses `foi-payment-sla` and `foi-process-audit` (process_type = fee-process).

nodes.name: Form Patch Already Done?
nodes.notes: A replayed PAID event that finds a PAID_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS row has already patched Form.io: skip the patch and resume at the email.

value.comments: ={{ 'Form.io submission patched; payment receipt email pending in execution ' + $execution.id + '. Row taken out of ACTIVE so the expiry job cannot expire a paid payment. A replay of the PAID event resumes at the email.' }}

nodes.name: Mark Side Effects Pending
nodes.notes: R09: runs after the Form.io patch and before the email. The row is no longer ACTIVE, so an email failure cannot make the payment eligible for expiry; the failed event is replayed and resumes at the email.

nodes.name: Get Latest Payment
nodes.notes: R09 verify-before-act: reads the latest payment version (GET /api/foipayment/{requestid}/ministryrequest/{id}) before the expiry call. Continues on error so a failed lookup is reported as NOT VERIFIED instead of failing the run.

nodes.name: Check Payment Verdict
nodes.notes: Why Code: unwraps the JSON-string API response and applies the unpaid / not System_Cancel rule in one place. EXPIRE only when the latest payment version is unpaid and not cancelled.

nodes.name: Payment Verdict Router
nodes.notes: EXPIRE: unpaid and not cancelled, send the expiry notification. ALREADY PAID / CANCELLED: close the row without notifying. NOT VERIFIED: lookup failed, leave the row ACTIVE for the next daily run.

nodes.name: Close Payment SLA - Already Paid/Cancelled
nodes.notes: R09: the payment was already PAID or cancelled, so the row is closed as PAID / CANCELLED and the expiry notification is not sent.

value.comments: ={{ $('Check Payment Verdict').first().json.note + ' Payment SLA #' + ($('Get Active Payment SLA').first().json.id ?? 'n/a') + ' closed.' }}

nodes.name: Audit: Expiry Suppressed
nodes.notes: Records that the expiry was suppressed because the payment was already paid or cancelled.

value.comments: ={{ 'Payment expiry skipped, payment not verified: ' + $('Check Payment Verdict').first().json.reason + '. Payment SLA #' + ($('Get Active Payment SLA').first().json.id ?? 'n/a') + ' stays ACTIVE and is retried by the next daily run.' }}

nodes.name: Audit: Expiry Not Verified
nodes.notes: The latest payment could not be read, so nothing is expired or notified; the row stays ACTIVE.

nodes.name: Cancel Already Done?
nodes.notes: A replayed CANCELLED event that finds a CANCEL_PENDING_SIDE_EFFECTS row has already cancelled the payment: skip the cancel API call and resume at the Form.io patch.

value.comments: ={{ 'Payment cancelled via API; Form.io patch pending in execution ' + $execution.id + '. Row taken out of ACTIVE so the expiry job cannot act on a cancelled payment. A replay of the CANCELLED event skips the cancel call and resumes at the Form.io patch.' }}

nodes.name: Mark Cancel Done
nodes.notes: R09 follow-up: runs right after the cancel API succeeds and before the Form.io patch. The row leaves ACTIVE, so a patch failure cannot let the expiry job act on it and a replay does not call the cancel API again.

nodes.name: Guard Form Ids - Paid
nodes.notes: Why Code: one node both stops the run with a clear message (G4) and builds the update payload. An IF plus Stop And Error would not build the payload.

nodes.name: Update Payment Form Submission - Paid
nodes.notes: Sets paymentstatus PAID and the next state on the applicant's payment submission. FOI Backend API Manager retries the PATCH (safe to repeat).

nodes.name: Guard Form Ids - Cancelled
nodes.notes: Why Code: one node both stops the run with a clear message (G4) and builds the update payload. An IF plus Stop And Error would not build the payload.

nodes.name: Update Payment Form Submission - Cancelled
nodes.notes: G14: sets paymentstatus CANCELLED on the payment submission (Camunda patches on every foi-manage-payment, so PAID and CANCELLED).
